title: home health director of operations
text:
**Benefits:**

* 401(k) matching
* Competitive salary
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

**About the Role:**

Caring Heart Hospice Inc is looking for a passionate and experienced Home Health Director of Operations to lead and grow our mission-driven team in Brentwood, CA. This is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact by overseeing the delivery of compassionate, high-quality home health services to patients and families who need it most.

**Responsibilities:**

* Oversee daily operations of home health services to ensure compliance, efficiency, and quality patient care
* Lead, mentor, and manage clinical and administrative staff across all departments
* Develop and implement operational policies, procedures, and performance improvement initiatives
* Monitor regulatory compliance with state, federal, and Medicare/Medicaid guidelines
* Collaborate with clinical leadership to maintain and improve patient outcomes and satisfaction
* Manage budgets, staffing, and resource allocation to meet organizational goals
* Build and maintain relationships with referral sources, physicians, and community partners

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, or a related field (Master's preferred)
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in home health or hospice operations management
* Strong knowledge of Medicare/Medicaid regulations and home health compliance standards
* Proven leadership and team-building skills in a clinical or healthcare setting
* Experience with budgeting, staffing, and operational planning
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills
* Active RN license or relevant clinical licensure is a plus

**About Us:**

Caring Heart Hospice Inc is a dedicated provider of compassionate home health and hospice care serving the Brentwood, CA community and surrounding areas. Our patients and families trust us to deliver dignified, personalized care during life's most challenging moments. Our team is united by a shared commitment to excellence, empathy, and making every day count for those we serve.
